evidence: Frozen bytes verified: sha256 of task/instruction.md 256c5b5d..., hireops_rules.md 38fff76c..., integration.md 1b56dd3f... match manifest.json lines 11-13. (1) Spelling: full read of all three files found no misspellings; scripted scan found no doubled words and no non-ASCII characters; rare-word lists contain only real words and seed names (Halvorsen, Sorensen, Fischer). Only spelling variance is British 'honour'/'honouring' in instruction.md:13 versus American 'Honor'/'honoring' in hireops_rules.md:201 and integration.md:7 -- both valid spellings, not a real error. (2) Contamination: grep for TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|placeholder|TBD|<tag>|drive-letter paths|/home/|/Users/|turing|qc|judge|rubric|criteri|playwright|golden|claude across instruction.md and both notes returned nothing. Template CHANGE_ME stubs (template instruction.md, notes.md) are fully replaced; template notes.md is replaced by task-specific hireops_rules.md. integration.md equals the template's plus a 5-line delivery paragraph (lines 16-19) about ordinary files/symlinks under /app -- a legitimate runtime constraint, not an aside. No author notes, no other machines' paths, no duplicated paragraphs. (3) Contradictions: account list instruction.md:17 matches seed users exactly (3 recruiters, 3 hiring managers, 1 observer, 3 candidates, same emails/roles); password Hireops!2026 identical in instruction.md:17 and hireops_rules.md:11; seed path /assets/seed_data.json consistent (instruction.md:13, integration.md:7, hireops_rules.md:206); '15 seconds' (rules:117) = 'fifteen seconds' (instruction.md:5); page size 30 (rules:144) = seed thread_page_size 30; candidate wording table (rules:183-190) = seed candidate_status_labels; 'three jobs' and 'one conversation is long' (rules:206-207) = seed (3 jobs; APP-101 has 120 messages); port 3000/PORT, /app/server.js, /app/app.db/DB_PATH, health route consistent across instruction.md:13, integration.md:3-10, rules:198-202; Activity example 'Mei Lin moved Priya Nair from Screen to Interview' (rules:111) is consistent with seed (Priya Nair APP-103 in SCREEN, Mei Lin a recruiter allowed on any job). No two clock values, account lists or seed paths. Minor observations, not defects: hireops_rules.md has ragged hard-wrap seams from later edits (line 91 breaks early after 'all the rules above,'; lines 99, 112, 173 and 180 run 111-169 chars against the ~105-char wrap) -- cosmetic markdown source formatting that renders as normal paragraphs, not pasted content; instruction.md:3 'as long as nobody has touched those cards since' is refined (not contradicted) by rules:98-99 'Adding a note does not count as a change', and instruction.md:11 delegates exact rules to that file. Adversarial angle: a model cannot be misled by any stray marker or conflicting value here; a conforming app following either 'honour'/'honor' text reads the same requirement. This row is source-only; no runtime evidence is required for it, and this verdict says nothing about Oracle, model or portal scores.
